summary: Teaches the 波段涨幅满足 (swing measured-move target) for a 下飘旗形 (downward-drifting flag, a bullish continuation 中继站). The target can only be computed after price breaks the prior swing high, which fixes the flag's pullback low: target = pullback_low + (swing_high - swing_start_low). Entry is the breakout above the flag's upper-edge neckline, the broken neckline becomes support/stop, and other continuation shapes (rectangles, triangles, wedges) work the same. Six Taiwan cases (中华车 weekly, 台股 daily, 佳格 weekly, 机电类 daily, 运输类 daily, 广丰 weekly) show the arithmetic, 2%-10% risk and 10%-200% gains.

patterns.name_zh: 下飘旗形（波段涨幅满足）
patterns.name_en: Down-drifting bull flag with swing measured-move target
patterns.structure: Up-leg from a swing low A (schematic 20) to a swing high B (35); then a pullback consolidation drifting downward between two parallel down-sloping lines (下飘旗形) to a low C (30). The flag's upper edge is the neckline. The book treats it as a mid-trend relay (中继站) of a bull swing; rectangles, converging/ascending/descending triangles and rising/falling wedges are equivalent relays (中华车 = 收敛三角形, 佳格 = 倾向下降楔形).
patterns.entry: Buy when price breaks above the flag's upper-edge neckline (schematic: neckline 33, buy ≈33.5). In cases the entry is on the breakout bar/week (台股 3/31 at ≈6630, 佳格 3/19 week at ≈40.5, 广丰 7/28 week at ≈13.5, 机电类 3/20 add-on at 90). An earlier 破底翻 entry at the base is used where available (机电类, 运输类).
patterns.stop: Close back below the broken neckline (跌落线下); the schematic says set a 5%-7% stop. Cases use the neckline-level or a nearby structural low: 台股 6504 (low of the volume up-move two days before), 佳格 38, 广丰 13, 机电类 add-on 88. 中华车: the structural stop 12.5 meant 10% risk, so the book uses 13.2 (≈5%) instead.

target.formula: target = C + (B - A), where A = swing start low, B = prior swing high, C = flag pullback low; valid only after price exceeds B (突破前高) which confirms C.

confirmation: Price must exceed the prior swing high B; only then is the pullback low C confirmed and the target computable (p29).
Neckline breakout with volume (带量突破: 中华车 12/25, 佳格 3/19) or a long red candle (佳格 4/30 长红突破前高).
A prior 破底翻 at the base of the swing (机电类 9/21, 运输类 3/4, 佳格 daily after the 6.26 low).
invalidation: After the neckline breakout, a close back below the neckline (颈线突破就不能再跌破).
At/near the target, a 假突破 (false breakout) is a profit-taking/sell signal (中华车 2004).

rules.rule: The swing measured move is NOT computed from the start of the rise; it requires a completed up-wave, a pullback consolidation, and a break of the prior high, which fixes the pullback low.
rules.quote_zh: 首先要了解波段涨幅满足不是从图示20开始起涨后就能计算，而是做对波段方向涨完一波回档整理后，再突破前高35，才能确定回档的低点是30，方能计算波段涨幅满足。

rules.rule: Target = pullback low + size of the first wave (low-to-high).
rules.quote_zh: ❶自20低点涨至35高点，共涨15。❷自30低点+15＝等幅计算的涨幅满足45。

rules.rule: A 下飘旗形 is usually a bull-swing relay; the breakout of its upper-edge neckline is the renewed bull attack signal, and the broken neckline must not be lost again.
rules.quote_zh: 通常下飘旗形为多头波段的中继站结构，当突破下飘旗形上缘颈线时，便可视为结束整理的多头再度攻击信号，当然颈线突破就不能再跌破。

rules.rule: Schematic trade: breakout at 33, buy ≈33.5 with a 5%-7% stop (close below the line); after the prior high 35 is cleared, 33 is support and the stop/take-profit point; hold while 33 holds and look for 45 (≈34% gain) — 'big wins, small losses'.
rules.quote_zh: 因此若照图示突破颈线上缘的位置是33，约可买在33.5，设5%～7%停损，也就是跌落线下时，……操作上就是支撑33不破，看涨幅满足45附近，获利约34%，这便是大赚小赔的操作方式。

rules.rule: Bull/bear relay consolidations also include rectangles and triangles (symmetric/inverted); flags are just the example.
rules.quote_zh: 多头波与空头波的整理中继站，还有矩形、三角形（正三角形、倒三角形）等，这里仅以上下飘旗形举例说明。

rules.rule: Up/down flags, rectangles, converging/ascending/descending triangles, rising/falling wedges are all relay consolidations; the measured move applies to them.
rules.quote_zh: 上下飘旗形、距形、收敛三角形、正三角形、倒三角形、上升楔形、下降楔形等等都是中继整理的一种，中华（中华车）周线为收敛三角形整理型态。

rules.rule: Bottom completion: a heavy-volume breakout above the neckline of a >1-year base is the buy; the stop is the start-low of the volume up-move (12.5); if that risk is too large (10%), use a nearer line stop (~5%).
rules.quote_zh: 12月25日带量突破颈线买进，约可买在13.9元附近，停损设12.5元，风险太高达10%，可设跌破13.2元停损也就是跌落线下时风险约5%

rules.rule: Exit the long at the big-swing target or when a false breakout is confirmed.
rules.quote_zh: 达大波段涨幅满足43.64元附近，或假突破确立，多单获利了结，获利约200%。

rules.rule: After the target zone, a prolonged range followed by a breakout that fails (false breakout) is a long-term sell; breaking the volume long-red low turns the trend short.
rules.quote_zh: 直到2004年2月7日当周才带量突破整理区，6周后出现假突破的长线卖出信号，同年4月24日当周跌破带量长红低点41.2元，翻空确立。

rules.rule: Staged entries: 破底翻 at the base is the first long; the flag-neckline breakout is the add-on; each has its own tight stop (2.3% / 2.2%).
rules.quote_zh: 2007年3月20日突破颈线下飘旗形确立，多单加码，约可买在90点，停损设88点，也就是跌落线下时，风险约2.2%。

rules.rule: In a strong bull run, the low of the last three trading days is the short-term strength gauge and a reference for scaling down at highs.
rules.quote_zh: 经验上当多头强势上涨时，可以三日低点做短线强弱的判断依据（目前交易日往前推三个交易日）做为高档减码的参考。

rules.rule: After heavy volume there is usually still a higher high, but risk is already high, especially at the target.
rules.quote_zh: 大量后虽大多有高点，但也表示风险已高，尤其是到达满足的时候。

rules.rule: History repeats in markets (Livermore quote), justifying pattern-based trading.
rules.quote_zh: 我很早就发现华尔街没有什么新东西，也不可能有什么新东西，因为股票投机历史悠久，今天在股市发生的一切都在以前发生过，也将在未来不断地再发生。

rules.rule: Breakout stop can be the low of the volume up-move that started the breakout (前两日开始带量上涨的低点).
rules.quote_zh: 停损设在前两日开始带量上涨的低点6504点附近，也是跌落颈线下时，风险约2%

worked_examples.pattern: 底形 → 收敛三角形中继 → 涨幅满足 → 假突破
worked_examples.outcome: Bottom breakout 2001-12-25 (heavy volume after >1 year); hit target, ranged >1 year above it; 2004-02-07 week breakout then 假突破 6 weeks later; 2004-04-24 week broke 41.2 → short confirmed. Long profit ≈200%.

worked_examples.instrument: 台股加权指数 (0000 大盘)
worked_examples.outcome: Neckline breakout 2006-03-31, prior high 6797 broken 4/8 (text) / 4/7 (chart); peaked 7476.07 just below target 7523 then fell; long profit ≈10%.

worked_examples.pattern: 下飘旗形（倾向下降楔形）
worked_examples.outcome: Daily 破底翻 after the 2008-11 low; 2011-03-19 week volume breakout of the flag neckline; 2011-04-30 week long red cleared 46.92; reached target (high 78.99); profit ≈90%.
破底翻 2006-09-21; neckline breakout 2007-03-20 (add-on); prior high 93.06 cleared 4/2; topped at 109.71 near target then fell sharply. Profit ≈19% (add-on) to ≈45% (破底翻 buy).
破底翻 2009-03-04 (entry); neckline breakout + prior-high break 4/2 confirmed target 89.56; reached ≈89.37; profit ≈43%.
Neckline breakout 2012-07-28 week; prior high 15.25 broken 8/18; reached target (high 19.90); profit ≈42%.

quantifiable: Bull flag: swing low A, swing high B (B > A), then a pullback C with A < C < B formed by lower highs/lower lows (down-sloping channel). Long trigger = close above the line through the flag's lower highs (upper edge).
Target is only armed when close > B after C: target = C + (B - A). Optional second check: report target hit when high >= target * (1 - tol).
Stop = close back below the broken flag upper edge (neckline) at the breakout bar; cap initial risk 5%-7%; if structural stop gives >~7-10% risk, use a nearer line stop (~5%).
Relay set: rectangle, triangles, wedges treated identically (same C + (B - A) arithmetic).
Breakout quality features: volume on breakout bar vs recent average; long red body; preceding 破底翻 at A.
Trend-following trailing rule: in strong rallies, trail with the lowest low of the last 3 trading days for scaling down at highs.
Exit/alert at target zone or on 假突破 (break above a range high followed by a close back inside).
ambiguities: 中华车 target computed as 24.59 + 18.98 = 43.57 (p32 观察) but the operation says 43.64 and a tiny chart label reads ≈43.69 — internal inconsistency in the book.
台股 example: text says the prior high 6797 was broken on 4月8日, chart label says 4/7.
p32 lists 距形, apparently a typo for 矩形 (rectangle).
Stop sizing is inconsistent: the schematic says set a 5%-7% stop, while cases use 2%-6% structural stops; whether the % cap or the neckline governs is not specified.
How the flag 'neckline' is drawn (line through which highs) is shown graphically only; for 佳格 the shape is called 倾向下降楔形 (closer to a falling wedge).
Reported profit percentages are measured to the target (e.g. 74→107.45 = 45%, 90→107.45 = 19%, 40.5→77.01 = 90%), not to the actual exit; 台股 'about 10%' is below 6630→7476 (12.8%).

中华车 starts the measured move from the bottom low 10.39, not from the neckline breakout — A is the swing's absolute low, consistent with the schematic but different from the W-bottom neckline method in u01/u03.

Small label at the 佳格 chart peak above 78.99 and the low-volume-side labels (e.g. under 6.26) are low-resolution; 78.99 taken from the boxed label.
